# Manage and More Design System

> Brand guidelines, design tokens and assets for Manage and More (endorsed brand of UnternehmerTUM). Sources: 2020 brand guideline PDF in source/ (print, identity) and the manageandmore.de codebase (screens, adopted 2026-10-07).

## Start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how agents use and extend this repo
- [Skill](skills/manage-and-more-brand/SKILL.md): brand essentials and review checklist
- [Asset catalogue](assets/catalog.json): every logo, label, icon, illustration, photo, font
- [Tokens](tokens/build/tokens.flat.json): colours, type, spacing, radii, layout, motion
- [Tailwind v4 theme](tokens/build/tailwind.theme.css)
